blocking_requirements.description: successor preregistration and measurement specification exist
primary U and complementary P/A/T metrics are frozen
successor classifier tests pass including phantom/substantiated boundary cases
hosted receiver A neutral access preflight passes
hosted receiver B neutral access preflight passes
successor receiver registry frozen after preflight
successor source packets and exact H1 projection bytes materialized/hash-bound
paired content-difference checker passes for all frozen pairs
exact run order generated and frozen
terminal-state schema and raw-output preservation records frozen
analysis program computes U/P/A/T and paired differences on synthetic fixtures

execution_rule: Do not execute corpus-bearing receiver requests until all blocking requirements are evidenced as satisfied in a successor freeze record.
non_claims: This gate does not prove the hypothesis.
This gate does not authorize production use.
Passing local CI is not equivalent to hosted receiver access.
